title: Effect of intraoperative delayed time on correction accuracy in 1050 Hz excimer laser-assisted in situ keratomileusis
indication: myopia and myopic astigmatism (eligibility: SE up to -10.00 D, astigmatism below 6.0 D, age 18-30 years, presbyopia excluded); 81 eyes of 81 patients
